name: Daily Profit
query:
SELECT
    DATE(si.posting_date) AS date,
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN (si.base_grand_total - (sii.base_net_rate * sii.qty)) > 0 
            THEN (si.base_grand_total - (sii.base_net_rate * sii.qty)) 
            ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS profit,
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN (si.base_grand_total - (sii.base_net_rate * sii.qty)) < 0 
            THEN ABS(si.base_grand_total - (sii.base_net_rate * sii.qty)) 
            ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS loss
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.posting_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE(si.posting_date)
ORDER BY DATE(si.posting_date);
